messages:
Marta S: Quick question  I'm hybrid in the EU office (0.8 FTE). A regional public holiday fell inside our Dec maintenance blackout and I was asked to cover an all-hands. Can I swap that bank holiday to a sick day or carry it into next year? cc @People Ops
People Ops: Hi Marta  you can't "convert" a statutory public holiday into a sick day (sick requires evidence and is for illness). For blackout situations we offer either pro-rated carryover or a payroll payout, subject to local law. For EU offices sometimes local law mandates payout.
Marta S: Hmm ok. My manager wanted to mark it as "emergency compensation" time-off instead of carryover. Is that allowed?
People Ops: We can do an off-cycle goodwill compensation (one-time floating day) in exceptional cases but it needs manager rationale + HR approval. Use the blackout-exception form and choose "compensation" and attach manager note.
Ivan P: I can confirm Marta was on the coverage rota; I support compensation vs payout. I'll add a short manager note.
People Ops: Thanks Ivan. Also note payroll cutoffs: if you request a payout and need it in Dec payroll, file 18 business days before payroll run. If you want a carryover or compensation floating day, no payroll cutoff, we'll apply to time-off balance.
Payroll Bot: Reminder: Dec payroll cutoff for region EU is Nov 22. Payout requests submitted after that roll to next cycle.
Marta S: Submitted the blackout-exception form, selected "compensation" and attached Ivan's note. Marked urgent because of travel plans early next year.
calendar-bot: FYI maintenance blackout Dec 23-27. See https://calendar.redwood/blackouts
People Ops: Received. Case HR-2026-5333 opened. We'll confirm local law requirements and whether compensation is allowable; expect update in 3-7 business days. If local law forces payout we'll offer that as an alternative.
Marta S: Thanks  appreciate the quick help! :pray:
